drugs.mechanism_cn: 抗 IL-23 单抗；抑制 IL-23 介导的炎症通路
drugs.mechanism_en: Anti-IL-23 monoclonal antibody; inhibits IL-23-mediated inflammatory pathways
drugs.notes_cn: 首个获批的 IL-23 抑制剂用于 UC，FDA 2023.10 批准，EMA 2023.5 批准。用于中重度活动性 UC 的二线治疗。
drugs.notes_en: First IL-23 inhibitor approved for UC. FDA approved Oct 2023, EMA approved May 2023. Second-line therapy for moderate-to-severe active UC.

drugs.mechanism_cn: S1P 受体调节剂（S1P1,4,5）；将淋巴细胞滞留于淋巴结，减少肠道炎症 T 细胞浸润
drugs.mechanism_en: S1P receptor modulator (S1P1,4,5); sequesters lymphocytes in lymph nodes, reducing intestinal inflammatory T cell infiltration
drugs.notes_cn: FDA 2023.10.13 批准，EC 2024.2.19 批准。Elevate UC 52 试验：32% 临床缓解率；Elevate UC 12：26%。
drugs.notes_en: FDA approved Oct 13, 2023; EC approved Feb 19, 2024. Elevate UC 52: 32% clinical remission; Elevate UC 12: 26%.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 抗 IL-23 单抗；选择性结合 IL-23 p19 亚基
drugs.mechanism_en: Anti-IL-23 monoclonal antibody; selectively binds IL-23 p19 subunit
drugs.notes_cn: 首个且唯一同时提供 SC 和 IV 诱导方案的 IL-23 抑制剂，用于 UC 和 CD。IV 诱导 2024.9 获批，SC 诱导 2025.9 获批。
drugs.notes_en: First and only IL-23 inhibitor offering both SC and IV induction for UC and CD. IV induction approved Sep 2024, SC induction approved Sep 2025.

drugs.mechanism_cn: JAK1 选择性抑制剂；抑制 JAK/STAT 通路 + 间接抑制 NLRP3-IL-1β 轴
drugs.mechanism_en: JAK1-selective inhibitor; inhibits JAK/STAT pathway + indirect inhibition of NLRP3-IL-1β axis
drugs.notes_cn: 对 JAK/STAT 和 NLRP3-IL-1β 轴的双重作用可能解释其在 UC 中的优越疗效。
drugs.notes_en: Dual action on JAK/STAT and NLRP3-IL-1β axis may explain superior efficacy in UC.

drugs.mechanism_cn: JAK1 偏好性抑制剂；抑制 JAK/STAT 通路
drugs.notes_cn: SELECTION 试验：2b/3 期双盲随机安慰剂对照，评估诱导和维持治疗。
drugs.notes_en: SELECTION trial: Phase 2b/3 double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, evaluating induction and maintenance.

drugs.mechanism_cn: JAK 抑制剂；抑制 JAK/STAT 通路
drugs.notes_cn: 首个获批的 JAK 抑制剂用于 UC。
drugs.notes_en: First JAK inhibitor approved for UC.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 抗 TL1A 单抗；结合可溶性和膜结合 TL1A，靶向免疫-纤维化
drugs.mechanism_en: Anti-TL1A monoclonal antibody; binds soluble and membrane-bound TL1A, targeting immuno-fibrosis
drugs.notes_cn: 2026.6 公布 ATLAS-UC III 期诱导研究阳性顶线结果，达到主要终点（12 周临床缓解），首个在 III 期证明疗效的抗 TL1A 抗体。
drugs.notes_en: June 2026: Positive topline results from Phase 3 ATLAS-UC induction study, met primary endpoint (12-week clinical remission). First anti-TL1A antibody to demonstrate efficacy in Phase 3.

drugs.notes_cn: SUNSCAPE-1 III 期诱导研究，2025.10 启动，预计 980 例入组，主要完成 2028.5。
drugs.notes_en: SUNSCAPE-1 Phase 3 induction study, started Oct 2025, ~980 enrollment, primary completion May 2028.

drugs.mechanism_cn: IL-23R 口服环肽抑制剂；阻断 IL-23 受体信号
drugs.mechanism_en: Oral IL-23R cyclic peptide inhibitor; blocks IL-23 receptor signaling
drugs.notes_cn: IIb 期：12 周临床响应率 63.5%，临床缓解率 30.2%，优于 IL-23 抗体。Protagonist 股价大涨 42%。
drugs.notes_en: Phase 2b: 12-week clinical response rate 63.5%, clinical remission 30.2%, superior to IL-23 antibodies. Protagonist stock surged 42%.

drugs.notes_cn: III 期头对头 vs Guselkumab，评估第 48 周临床缓解。
drugs.notes_en: Phase 3 head-to-head vs Guselkumab, evaluating Week 48 clinical remission.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 抗 TL1A 抗体（延长半衰期）；高 potency + 长半衰期设计
drugs.mechanism_en: Anti-TL1A antibody (extended half-life); designed for high potency + long half-life
drugs.notes_cn: 半衰期 >71 天，支持 12 周维持给药。XENITH-UC IIb 期于 2025 下半年启动。
drugs.notes_en: Half-life >71 days, supporting 12-week maintenance dosing. XENITH-UC Phase 2b started H2 2025.

drugs.mechanism_cn: PDE4 抑制剂（局部作用）；抑制磷酸二酯酶 4
drugs.notes_cn: Ib 期 UC 队列：100%（5/5）临床应答，平均修订 Mayo 评分下降 62.8%。计划 2026 上半年推进 II 期。
drugs.notes_en: Phase 1b UC cohort: 100% (5/5) clinical response, mean modified Mayo score reduction 62.8%. Plans to advance to Phase 2 in H1 2026.

drugs.mechanism_cn: T 细胞耗竭剂；耗竭致病性 T 细胞
drugs.mechanism_en: T cell depleter; depletes pathogenic T cells
drugs.notes_cn: 第 12 周未达到主要终点（改良 Mayo 评分变化）及关键次要终点。尽管实现 ~90% 致病性 T 细胞耗竭，疗效不足，UC 项目终止。
drugs.notes_en: Failed to meet primary endpoint (mean change in modified Mayo Score) and key secondary endpoints at Week 12. Despite ~90% pathogenic T cell depletion, efficacy was insufficient. UC program discontinued.
